title: Storage Space and Windows Performance
overview: Windows needs free storage for updates, temporary files, application caches, and virtual memory. Cleanup recommendations help identify removable content while keeping the user in control of what is deleted.
checklist: Open Settings > System > Storage and review the Windows drive.
Treat less than about 10 percent free space as a warning sign.
Open Cleanup recommendations and review every category before selecting files.
Move important personal files to an approved backup location before removing them.
Never manually delete Windows, Program Files, or unfamiliar system folders.
common_indicators: Updates fail because additional space is required.
Applications cannot save or create temporary files.
Disk activity remains high while little free space is available.
Performance improves after safe cleanup and restart.
